---
title: "Cleanup suggestion branch"
description: "Deletes bot and agent branches once their pull request is closed."
---

`cleanup-suggestion-branch.yml` deletes the branch of a closed pull
request — merged or not — if it is a branch of a bot or an agent and no
other open pull request still uses it:

- `bot-suggest/*`: the suggestion bots' branches;
- `agent-suggest/*`: branches of coding agents, e.g. the issue
  implementer's or a Claude Code session's (`agent-suggest/<type>/<topic>`).

Branches with other names, e.g. your own feature branches, are never
touched. Only branches of the repository itself are deleted, never a
fork's.

## Example

{{< example cleanup-suggestion-branch.yml >}}

The workflow only runs if this caller exists on the **base branch** of the
closed pull request: for suggestion PRs that is your feature branch, for
scheduled runs and [full reviews](suggestions.qmd#full-review) usually
`dev`. Adding it to `dev` covers both,
since feature branches start from there.
